records.claim: Free-flying mosquitoes can survive direct raindrop impacts due partly to low body mass and reduced momentum transfer.
records.limitations: Surviving impacts does not establish how mosquitoes predict rain or whether rainfall sounds repel them.

records.claim: Ir93a-dependent mosquito sensory systems contribute to humidity and temperature detection and host-proximity behavior.
records.method: Genetic perturbation, neural calcium imaging and behavior
records.limitations: Receptor disruption is not evidence that artificial electronic signals can mimic humidity.

records.claim: Insulated-conductor electric-field barriers affected Aedes aegypti passage in controlled experiments.
records.limitations: Does not establish neuronal field sensing or safe practical deployment; no construction guidance provided.

records.claim: Male Culex quinquefasciatus mosquitoes use Johnston's organ to detect female-like flight tones.
records.method: Physiological modeling with free-flight behavioral assay
records.limitations: Mate localization is not evidence of general audio repellency or electric-field sensitivity.

records.claim: In field trapping experiments wind-associated reductions in mosquito catches were consistent with dilution of attractant cues rather than simple flight incapacity.
records.species: Aedes vexans; Anopheles walkeri; Coquillettidia perturbans
records.method: CO2-baited field trapping with fan-generated wind
records.limitations: Trapping results do not directly establish bite prevention or all-species generality.

note: Source-inspected means abstract/full text inspected, NOT independently replicated or verified. Claims and limitations must remain together.
